Market today: Stocks are falling as the 10-year Treasury yield nears 5%, a major headwind for your tech and chip names. CoreWeave's strong earnings offer a glimmer of hope for AI, but the broader market mood is cautious.

Your holdings: SOXL is down a brutal -75.06%, MUU -59.4%, and SPAL -42.98%. These leveraged ETFs amplify drops, and with margin, drawdowns hurt extra. SMCI is also down -36.67%.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the 10-year Treasury yield. Any further climb will pressure your book. Also, watch for any follow-through from the CoreWeave AI news.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your deeply underwater leveraged positions in this rising rate environment.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL given the -75.06% loss and leveraged nature; re-evaluate stop at 200, it's too far.
Review MUU's stop at 31.6; the -59.4% loss on a leveraged ETF is a major concern.
Consider a defensive play with SQQQ; scanner entry 43.52-43.47, stop 43.37, to hedge against tech declines.
